basic_info.description: Beautifully updated first-floor flat in the heart of Corona Heights combines modern comfort with timeless charm. The spacious living room with fireplace flows into a dining area and chef-inspired kitchen featuring white shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. Freshly painted interiors, wide-plank floors, updated baths, and dual-pane windows, create a move-in-ready space that feels warm and inviting. The terraced backyard is a shared oasis with multiple levels for outdoor dining, lounging, and play, complete with a tranquil fountain and mature landscaping. An independent parking garage adds convenience and storage. Perfectly located near Corona Heights Park and just minutes from the Castro, Cole Valley, Haight-Ashbury, Lower Haight, Buena Vista Park, and MUNI, this home offers an exceptional opportunity to own a stylish retreat in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
